name: Team Minik — 7-email sequence (home sellers / buyers)
target: Homeowners considering selling and buyers entering the market, primarily Arizona then the 22-plus states the team covers. Buying signals: expired listing, FSBO, relocation, life event (new job, growing family), recent home-value lookups. The offer: a top-1-percent team with 354 million in volume handling the whole sale or search.
voice_notes: Direct consumer outreach. Michelle writes as the agent, warm and direct. Concrete proof (354M volume, 1,534-plus clients, top 1 percent, media features). NO em-dashes, NO smart quotes, NO ellipses, NO exclamation marks, NO emojis. P.S. on every email with a second specific give. Required merges: {first_name}. Optional: {city}.

performance.title: Projected performance at 600 emails/day
performance.disclaimer: This is an estimate, not a promise or guarantee of results. Cold-email outcomes vary with list quality, deliverability, the offer, market timing, and follow-up. The numbers below are modeled from typical consumer cold-outbound conversion rates applied to your own commission economics, shown conservative and optimistic so you can judge the range.
performance.value_note: Value per closed transaction: on a median sale near $400,000 at a ~2.5% listing-side commission that is ~$10,000 gross; on the team's 15% share before the $14k cap that is roughly $1,500 to the team per deal as a floor, with the agent keeping the rest. Using a blended ~$9,000 team-side contribution per closed transaction (mix of listing + buyer sides, higher-value homes, and post-cap 100% deals) is a reasonable planning figure.
performance.bottom_line: Even at the conservative end (2 extra closings a month), a single 600/day seller channel points to roughly six figures a year in added commission, before referrals and repeat business. As with recruitment, the real limit is how many clients the team can serve well, not how many leads the campaign produces.

variants.subject: quick question about your home, {first_name}?
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

Quick question, no pressure.

I lead a real estate team here at Realty of America. Over 25 years I have closed more than 1,534 sales and 354 million in volume, and my team handles the whole process for sellers and buyers so you are not chasing anything yourself.

If you have thought at all about selling or buying in the next year, the market and your home value are worth a quick look before you decide anything.

Would a free, no-obligation 15-minute call be useful?

If not, reply with a no and I will not follow up.

P.s. whether we ever work together or not, reply VALUE and I send you a free valuation for your address with three recent comparable sales. No call needed.

variants.subject: what the call covers
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

Quick follow up.

Here is exactly what the 15 minutes covers. I tell you what your home would realistically sell for today, the three or four highest-return things to do before listing, and a clear timeline. If you are buying, we map your budget, the areas, and what is actually moving.

No obligation, no pressure to list. You get straight answers from a team that has closed more than 1,600 homes.

Would this week work for a quick call?

P.s. the free valuation is still yours if you want it without a call. Reply VALUE.

variants.subject: 1,600 closings of pricing data
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

One thing that matters most when you sell.

Price. Set it wrong and the home sits, then you cut and lose money. Set it right and it moves fast and at the top of the range.

We price using data from more than 1,600 real closings, not a guess. That is the difference between a home that lingers and one that sells for top dollar.

For your home, that same approach would tell you the real number today.

15 minutes for a no-obligation valuation and a plan?

P.s. happy to send our seller prep checklist so you can see the highest-return moves before listing. Reply CHECKLIST.

variants.subject: you are busy, here is why it matters
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

Fourth note, you are clearly busy. Last one before I switch to give-only mode.

Here is why I keep reaching out.

The cost of working with the wrong agent or mispricing a home is real. Homes that sit, price cuts, and a stressful drawn-out sale. The cost of a quick call with a proven team is 15 minutes.

My team has closed more than 1,600 homes and 354 million in volume, and we handle the work so you make the decisions. If now is not the time to sell, I will tell you honestly.

Reply with a time or a no. Either one is fine.

P.s. still happy to send the free valuation with no call. Reply VALUE.

variants.subject: {first_name}, yes or no
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

Clean question.

If a top-1-percent team with 354 million in volume gave you a free valuation, a clear plan to sell for top dollar or find the right home, and handled the whole process so you did not have to, would you say yes to a free 15-minute call?

A clear yes or a clear no. Either one is the right answer for me.

P.s. if it is a no for now, the free valuation and the seller prep checklist are still yours. Reply VALUE or CHECKLIST.

variants.subject: two things you can use whether you sell or not
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

Switching to give-only mode as promised.

Two things, both yours:

1) A free, no-obligation valuation for your address with three recent comparable sales, so you know where you stand. Reply VALUE.

2) Our seller prep checklist, the highest-return things to do before listing so you do not overspend on the wrong fixes. Reply CHECKLIST.

No call, no obligation, no follow-up sequence after this. Take either or both.

variants.subject: closing your file
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

Closing your file with my team today, so this is my last note.

Three last things.

If the timing was wrong, that is fine. Tell me roughly when you might sell or buy and I will reach back out then with current numbers.

If something did not land, tell me what. I read every reply.

If nothing was right, no hard feelings. The free valuation and the seller prep checklist are still yours. Just reply VALUE or CHECKLIST and I send them with no call attached.

Wishing you the best with your home.
